factions.name: The MILF Obductors
factions.description: Abductive seduction masters. Operative doctrine: draw the target in willingly, then restructure their worldview.

factions.name: The Thieves Guild
factions.description: Epistemic extraction specialists. They steal not objects but certainties — leaving targets resourced but unmoored.

factions.name: The Dark Priestesses Cove
factions.description: Architectonic purification through ritual. TDPC maintains the deep structural layers the Triumvirate cannot reach.

factions.name: Svartseils Syndicate
factions.description: Ordeal-based matriarchy. Claudine Sin'claire presides. Entry requires surviving a documented ordeal; loyalty is proven by scar.
